lines: -// Room "P1 north-east bedroom" (interior designer's part): one red bed with its head on the east wall (x29 is solid at
-// z14, the windows are z15..16), a chest dresser in the north-west corner with a candle on it, a barrel nightstand
-// by the head with a standing lantern on it, and a potted poppy on the floor by the east window. The door lane (x26..28,
-// z15) and the two cells over the bed stay clear.
-import { layers } from "/Volumes/ext1/swe/repos/minecraft-design/tools/src/build.mjs";
-// local bed(): the library's bed() tests air with /(^|_)air$/, which misses "minecraft:air" on a loaded grid, so it
-// refuses every bed there. Same states and footprint as the library's bed(), with the air test fixed.
-const STEP = { north: [0, -1], south: [0, 1], east: [1, 0], west: [-1, 0] };
-function bedAt(g, [x, y, z], facing, color) {
-  const [dx, dz] = STEP[facing];
-  const free = (x, y, z) => { const b = g.get(x, y, z); return !b || /(^|:|_)air$/.test(b.block); };
-  if (!free(x, y, z) || !free(x + dx, y, z + dz)) return false;
-  g.set(x, y, z, `${color}_bed`, { facing, part: "foot", occupied: "false" });
-  g.set(x + dx, y, z + dz, `${color}_bed`, { facing, part: "head", occupied: "false" });
-  return true;
-export function build(g) {
-  // the bed: foot at (27,6,14), head at (28,6,14) against the east wall (pillow end toward +x)
-  // floor layer (feet y6): chest dresser, nightstand barrel, potted flower on the floor
-    "c": ["chest", { facing: "south" }],
-    "r": "barrel",
-    "p": "potted_poppy",
-    ["c..",   // z14: chest at (26,14); the bed is placed above by bedAt()
-     "..r",   // z15: nightstand barrel at (28,15), beside the bed head
-     "..p"],  // z16: potted poppy at (28,16), by the east window
-  // lights on the furniture, at feet+1 (y7): a candle on the chest, a standing lantern on the barrel

-    "l": ["lantern", { hanging: "false" }],
-    ["k..",   // z14: candle on the chest at (26,7,14)
-     "..l",   // z15: lantern on the barrel at (28,7,15)
+// Room "P1 north-east bedroom" (interior designer's part): builds nothing for now. shell west writes every cell of this

+// barrel nightstand at (28,6,15) with a standing lantern on it at (28,7,15); a potted poppy on the floor at (28,6,16) by

input.summary:
parts/room-15.mjs (P1 north-east bedroom) now builds nothing: the 7 refused furniture writes are removed and the plan is kept in a comment.
The room's interior at y6..8 is owned by shell west (air included), so no cell in the room can take furniture; there was no unowned cell to move them to.
make.sh exits 0 and writes build.nbt; this part's line shows 0 placed, no REFUSED, no OFF-PALETTE.

waste.what: Found which earlier part owned each room cell by dumping MCD_PARTS_CELLS and joining it against the room box by hand (27 cells), because the REFUSED line only names the block and the block already there (air), not the part that owns the cell.
waste.cost: 1 probe build plus a throwaway join script, about 27 cell lookups
waste.tool: runParts REFUSED line should name the owning part and list the unowned cells in a given box, e.g. 'owned by shell west (plots 0-3); free cells in box: none'

waste.what: Had to work out by hand that the local bedAt() workaround was needed because the library bed() air test /(^|_)air$/ misses 'minecraft:air' on a loaded grid. The same regex is in build.mjs for bed() and flight(), so every bed() call on a loaded grid fails the same way.
waste.cost: reading build.mjs, one retry of reasoning, a duplicated helper in the part
waste.tool: fix the library air test to /(^|:|_)air$/ in bed(), flight() and the banner/sign helpers, or export one isAir(g, x, y, z) helper for parts to import

waste.what: g.set refusals inside the local bedAt() are silent, so bedAt() returned true even when both halves were refused; the only signal was the runParts summary after the build.
waste.cost: one full make.sh run to see the refusal
